name: vp-real-estate
description: Commercial real estate lease analysis, expropriation, appraisal, and linear infrastructure plugins for property professionals

plugins.name: leasing-commercial
plugins.description: Commercial lease analysis: abstraction, effective rent, tenant credit, options valuation, IFRS 16, consents, surrender, compliance

plugins.name: tenancies-residential
plugins.description: Ontario Residential Tenancies Act: eviction procedures, LTB hearings, tenant relief analysis

plugins.name: expropriation-law
plugins.description: Ontario Expropriations Act: statutory interpretation, compensation entitlement, procedural defects, deadline tracking, Forms 1-12, settlement, severance damages, injurious affection

plugins.name: appraisal-valuation
plugins.description: Property valuation: cost approach, income approach, easement valuation, comparable sales adjustment (DCA + MCDA), title, environmental due diligence

plugins.name: infrastructure-corridor-ops
plugins.description: Linear infrastructure acquisition: agricultural easements, cropland compensation, land assembly, public consultation, NIMBY response, transit station siting, transmission line specs, right-of-way

plugins.name: common-utilities
plugins.description: Foundation plugin: analyst trio personas (Adam/Reggie/Dennis), cross-cutting skills, canonical Shared_Utils, subagent-stop hook
